fields.description: Program Description Campus: Putuo Campus Program Duration: March 1st, 2027 - June 18th, 2027 (the first week is orientation week and classes start from March 8th, 2027). *16 weeks in total (the orientation week included). In case of Chinese public holidays and school activities, classes will be adjusted or suspended. *From December 28th, 2026, the school will notify admitted students by email in batches to complete the Chinese proficiency questionnaire and take an online placement interview. Please ensure that student email addresses are accurate and valid. Duration: one semester or more Class Schedule: 29 class hours per week (1 class hour = 45 minutes) Morning: From Monday to Friday 8:30-11:45 Afternoon: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday 13:15-15:45 Class opening conditions: Application Requirements: Classes are offered at levels from intermediate to advanced (Intermediate, Pre-Advanced, Advanced). Class Opening Conditions: Each level requires a minimum of 8 students to open. Textbook: A Practical Business Chinese Reader, Erya Chinese, Excel in Chinese, etc.It will be adjusted according to the actual situation. The cost of teaching materials is at your own expense. Course description Specially designed for those who will or have already engaged in business or trade career under Chinese-related background. Offer appropriate courses for students of different levels to meet their needs at different learning stages. Help students obtain a larger vocabulary and specialized knowledge of business purpose. Enhance students' understanding of contemporary Chinese economy and finance through diverse courses. Cultivate students' communication skills in business surroundings through various scenario simulations like negotiation, speech, etc. Regularly arrange business themed lectures and on-site visits to companies. fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents in time. * 1. Copy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. * 3. Highest education certificate Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 4. Highest education transcript Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 5. Chinese Language Proficiency Certificate Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Age requirement: 18-55 years old (age calculated as of March 1, 2027). Applicants who are 16 years old or above but under 18 years old will be subject to an additional review by the university. Applicants must have attained HSK Level 3 or above.
